decision: write REQ-0011: a Scorecard with a repeated criterion_id is not loaded
why: the glossary calls criterion_id the identifier of a Criterion, yet a Scorecard with two Criteria named alike loads, takes one Finding for both and only fails when the Evaluation is concluded
evidence: apps/call-qa-agent/tests/acceptance/test_scorecard.py fails on criterion_ids ('c0', 'c0') before the fix

decision: raise ValueError in cli.load_scorecard, where a Scorecard enters the app
why: it is a fault in a file a person wrote, so it is refused at the boundary before any request is made; no Rejection, which would need a new RejectionRule and an ontology change
evidence: cli.load_scorecard is the only loader: cli.main and tests/conftest.py

decision: keep the repro as TST-0012, over every Scorecard of up to three Criteria named from three names
why: 39 files cover every way a name can repeat within the bound, and the commit before the fix shows the test failing on ('c0', 'c0')
evidence: apps/call-qa-agent/tests/acceptance/test_scorecard.py; call-qa tools --scorecard on a file with two c0 Criteria now ends in ValueError
